title: Threat model records per system and material change
description: Versioned threat models in Tutela's model (assets, trust boundaries, threats, invariants, controls, evidence, unknowns) for each system and each material change, with reviewer, date and release posture.
producer: Tutela (exists as a discipline and toolset; no product threat model located)
format: Tutela records plus Folio-rendered Security Evidence Record

title: Trust boundary and data flow inventory
description: Machine-readable inventory of trust boundaries, data flows, data classifications crossing each boundary and the enforcing control, checked against deployed configuration.
format: JSON or YAML model plus rendered diagram

title: Architectural assurance matrix
description: Per-release matrix that classifies each security property as proven, structurally enforced, empirically tested or unverified, with scope, exclusions, enforcing mechanism, bypass tests and evidence links.
notes: Named as assurance deliverable 4 in the Secure Construction Standard v0.1.

title: Bypass and negative test results for structural claims
description: Results of tests that attempt to defeat each by-construction claim: raw database connections, stored procedures with dynamic SQL, HTML injection through interop, script injection in generated bundles, unsafe interop, reflection, with seeded fixtures that the checks must detect.

title: Domain type and state machine conformance report
description: Report listing domain types with private constructors and their validation functions, state machines with their legal transitions, and exhaustive-match enforcement settings; with property test results.

title: Database access architecture evidence
description: Database role and grant export, list of database functions and their use of dynamic SQL, row-level security policies per tenant table, Strata drift status for all security-relevant objects, and list of every credential that can connect to the database.
producer: Strata (exists; schema compile, diff and drift) plus database catalog export (proposed)
format: Strata plan and diff output plus catalog export

title: Browser surface inventory
description: Per-release inventory of every script, WebAssembly module, interop export and third-party resource loaded by each page, with digests, origin and approval, plus the deployed CSP and Subresource Integrity settings.

title: Security design review and decision records
description: Records of security design review for new data categories, external APIs, autonomous permissions and financial workflows, with reviewer independence, decision, conditions and linked decision record.

title: Failure mode and fail-closed test results
description: Tests that inject dependency failures, timeouts, unknown states and partial outages into security decisions and assert deny or hold behavior.
